title: wayfinder: an ADRs-only ending after the first map, the prototype order, and its own pull requests merge on green
story: /wayfinder now offers a third ending, ADRs only, once a project has a PRD: each decision becomes a pending ADR in one pull request a person merges, and the PRD question is skipped. A PRD map ends by naming the order: the PRD, then /prd-to-tickets drafts any missing prototype screens, then the cut. Its other pull requests merge on green.

checks.criterion: The destination question shows two options when there is no PRD, and three once one exists.
checks.steps: In a throw-away project with orion installed and docs/PRDs/ empty, run /wayfinder plan a made-up feature. Then add a made-up PRD under docs/PRDs/ and run it again.
checks.expected: First run: PRD and TICKETS only. Second run: PRD, ADRS and TICKETS, with the recommendation rule shown.
